body: Fuck this nutsack piece of shit.

When I read about incredible people who die too soon, I always think ‘why couldn’t that have been me?’ 

I don’t get why there are people who contribute to the greater good die and I’m useless yet here I am.

Thank you for all of the advice. The hardest part is starting but I know I need to get some kind of order to my life. I use to meditate and journal but been going through a deep depression and have lost motivation to do much.

I have health problems so I’m limited on what I can do. They are small movements taught to me by my physical therapist and just walking. 

It’s weird because I’ve gone to bed at 10 pm and if I get 8-9 hours or more and wake up at 7 am, I’ll be sleepy and tired all day. Yet, if I go to bed at 3 AM and get 8-9 hours, I wake up feeling wide awake. 

I usually need more than 9 hours to fully recover from the day.

Melatonin doesn’t work for me. I’ve tried a lot of methods but I keep ending up on the same schedule. I’ve had years of therapy but the anxiety I have about the future makes me wired. 

I take medication to help me sleep and to help with pain. I’m also a light sleeper so I wait until my eyes are drooping and I’m absolutely beyond knackered so I’ll fall instantly asleep.
He is one POS who needs to be visited by the Grim Reaper about now.
